design.split_rule: locked CV fold0: Fit original folds3+4, Calibration fold2, Evaluation folds0+1; split frozen before new gate feature computation
design.feature: central48-sample derivative-energy / maximum48-sample derivative-energy in256; strongest support-center offset
design.gate_rule: reject iff ratio < t AND strongest support offset>40samples; never reject on RR or absolute slope
design.selection: Fit matched-PVC rejection <=0.1%; Calibration zero matched-PVC rejection, no increase FN, no F1 reduction on either dataset; maximize worst-dataset F1 gain then total FP reduction; smaller threshold tie
design.latency: window complete at center+127; no additional samples beyond existing256 window
design.evaluation_limit: Evaluation groups not used to select this gate; previously exposed in V1-V11 research, not independent new patients
design.matching: unchanged greedy one-to-one +/-38samples, full BEATS; OTHER not N; missing V=FN, missing N abstention, unmatched PVC alarm=FP
design.test_access: forbidden; historical Test metrics not used
